blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Team Philippines continues its campaign in the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya on Tuesday with more athletes seeing action across several sports. The Philippines has a shot at its first gold medal in mixed martial arts, while Filipino swimmers return to action in Tokyo. The Gilas Pilipinas women’s teams see action in 5-on-5 and 3×3, while the women’s gymnastics team begins its qualification campaign and Filipino fencers open their bids in Japan.
